subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this remain the canonical Google Chat Space mention-detection/session-creation bug until live proof is available, or should maintainers consolidate it into the broader Google Chat Space routing backlog?
rationale: Source review shows a plausible pre-session mention-gate drop and reporter comments show current release impact, but the exact live annotation payload and consolidation boundary need maintainer judgment before automation should write a fix.

options.title: Keep Canonical Pending Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open as the focused Space mention-detection bug and request redacted live payload/log proof before implementation.

options.title: Consolidate Into Space Routing
options.body: Move the remaining requirement into the broader Google Chat Space routing item if maintainers want one backlog owner for mention, thread, and all-message behavior.

options.title: Treat Config Workaround As Enough
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide requireMention:false is the supported operator workaround for current HTTP-endpoint Space deployments.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Pending Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the focused Space mention-detection bug and request redacted live payload/log proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent carried the related classifier PR and current Google Chat files, making him the strongest routing candidate for the proof/consolidation choice.
